name: 全局结构辨识战役
objective: 从同一响应张量中竞争性识别紧凑结构，并用主动干预和封存集批量淘汰机制强版本。
scope: Qwen3、GLM4、DeepSeek；受控关系世界与结构匹配的自然概念世界；内容、角色、协议、操作和生成轨迹。
budget_status: WP00 冻结：战役总上限 24 GPU-hours；每个工作包独立硬上限
success_condition: 至少一个紧凑结构在封存的新世界、新干预和多步轨迹上显著优于设计基线，并进入 L4 以上闭环；或所有已注册强版本在其声明范围内被批量关闭。
stop_condition: 达到正式 Phase 或计算预算上限；封存确认完成；所有候选预测不可区分；或构念/仪器前提失败。

stages.name: 基线迁移与合同冻结
stages.entry_gate: Phase 1235 已停止自动续行，用户授权范式切换。
stages.exit_gate: 关键证据可追溯；构念、假说、生死条件、数据分房和预算均冻结。

stages.name: 相机与行为资格
stages.entry_gate: WP00 完成。
stages.exit_gate: 各构念独立通过或关闭；相机在已知真值中通过识别、拒答和特异性门。

stages.name: 全域低成本扫描
stages.entry_gate: 至少一个内容或操作对象获得相应行为授权。
stages.exit_gate: 所有预注册层、位置、词元步和读出完成统一采集。

stages.name: 未来响应张量试采集
stages.entry_gate: WP02 确定少量事件集合，干预相机控制合格。
stages.exit_gate: 响应张量可重算、控制干净、缺失与删失规则冻结。

stages.name: 结构发现与机制竞赛
stages.entry_gate: WP03 通过。
stages.exit_gate: 所有候选输出封存预测、描述长度和最大分歧实验。

stages.name: 主动决定性实验
stages.entry_gate: 至少两个候选在允许实验上给出可分预测。
stages.exit_gate: 达到假说对覆盖目标或预算上限，且选择规则未使用确认集。

stages.name: 一次性封存确认
stages.entry_gate: 候选、阈值、代码和确认材料全部冻结。
stages.exit_gate: 最多保留两个机制；其余按适用域归档。

stages.name: 因果与自回归闭环
stages.entry_gate: 存在封存确认幸存机制。
stages.exit_gate: 同一对象达到 L5 或 L6；若失败则明确最高闭合层级。

stages.name: 组合与跨模型
stages.entry_gate: 至少一个对象达到 L5。
stages.exit_gate: 未见组合和跨模型响应映射完成封存验证或限定失败。

stages.name: 训练形成
stages.entry_gate: 已识别可测的功能状态或局部模体。
stages.exit_gate: 分别裁决是否形成、何时形成和形成何种实现。

name: 未来响应对象与机制结构竞赛战役
objective: 把 gold 正确性与模型自身干预响应分账，从隐藏到响应的已知真值校准出发，建立未来响应张量、竞争结构、决定性干预和同一对象纵向闭环。
scope: 先在自由微型 Transformer 校准真正成像端；通过后只对 Qwen3 开启全新模型自身响应试采，随后按预测、特异性、救援、组合和形成逐门升级。
budget_status: WP00 使用 0.000816 GPU-hour 并通过；WP01 使用 0.127674 GPU-hour 后在外部效度主门停止；其余预算未获授权。
success_condition: 同一自然功能对象至少达到 L5：响应可重复、可预测未见干预、超过匹配控制、经决定性干预与救援确认，并明确其适用域；或所有候选被批量关闭并产出可识别性边界。
stop_condition: 相机前提失败；达到正式 phase 或 GPU 上限；所有结构候选在封存确认中不可区分；或同一对象无法继续合法升级。

stages.name: 隐藏到响应相机校准
stages.entry_gate: Phase1246 已确认旧相机只覆盖 response-to-adjudication；C002 对象、确认集、阈值和代码已冻结。
stages.exit_gate: 双架构多数自由网络通过预测、特异性与类型化可识别性四门，或该相机在限定作用域内关闭。

stages.name: Qwen3 模型自身响应张量试采
stages.entry_gate: WP00 四门全部通过；另行冻结全新合同、材料和 Qwen3 数值资格。
stages.exit_gate: gold 与 model-self 双账、最小对象正交化及正确/错误样本响应张量完成。

stages.name: 响应结构竞赛
stages.entry_gate: WP01 得到可重算且超过 matched-null 的响应张量。
stages.exit_gate: 固定方向、条件映射、局部程序轨迹和门控超图按未见预测与描述长度裁决。

stages.name: 主动决定性干预
stages.entry_gate: 至少两个结构候选产生可区分的前瞻预测。
stages.exit_gate: 用最小预算覆盖幸存候选对，确认材料保持密封。

stages.name: 一次性封存确认
stages.entry_gate: 结构、阈值、代码和全新确认材料全部冻结。
stages.exit_gate: 最多保留两个候选；其余按作用域关闭。

stages.name: 同一对象因果与生成闭环
stages.entry_gate: 至少一个响应结构通过封存确认。
stages.exit_gate: 预测、必要性、充分性、救援、多步自回归与缓存轨迹在同一对象上分账闭合。

stages.name: 组合与跨模型功能映射
stages.entry_gate: 同一对象达到 L5。
stages.exit_gate: 未见组合和跨模型响应组合表通过，或在明确边界内失败。

stages.name: 训练形成与理论最小公理化
stages.entry_gate: 已得到可预测、可干预和可救援的功能状态或局部算子。
stages.exit_gate: 形成顺序、形成前预测与训练干预得到裁决；仅在产生额外未见预测时最小公理化。

name: Source identifiability and multi-event response-camera campaign
objective: Determine whether the Phase1248 direct/code split is caused by mathematical source-observation nonidentifiability, then test a fixed equal-budget multi-event trajectory camera in free known-truth Transformers before any pretrained-model rerun.
scope: Phase1249 is a no-model exact-collision audit of the frozen Phase1248 source observation. Phase1250 is a one-shot two-architecture known-truth calibration. Qwen3 is authorized only if the frozen 3-of-4 breadth conjunction passes.
budget_status: WP00 used no GPU. WP01 used 0.033642 GPU-hour and failed the 3-of-4 breadth gate. WP02 was not authorized.
success_condition: Exact source collisions are established and at least three of four free Transformers, with both architectures represented, pass the frozen multi-event prediction and specificity gates; only then may one fresh Qwen3 external-validity contract open.
stop_condition: The source collision is absent, the known-truth breadth conjunction fails, the artifact chain is invalid, or the one-shot GPU budget is reached.

stages.name: Frozen source-observation identifiability audit
stages.entry_gate: Phase1248 artifacts, event, projection, alpha and confirmation groups remain frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Exact same-source observations with separated responses across later contexts are recomputed, or source nonidentifiability is rejected.

stages.name: Known-truth multi-event trajectory camera
stages.entry_gate: WP00 authorizes a mathematically different context-bearing observation object; families, dimensions, thresholds, worlds and seeds are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: At least three of four networks and both architectures pass direct/code prediction, source advantage and specificity, or the bundle closes without reselection.

stages.name: Fresh Qwen3 multi-event external validity
stages.entry_gate: WP01 full conjunction passes without threshold relaxation.
stages.exit_gate: A separately frozen Qwen3 contract adjudicates external validity.

name: Causal-slice observation-object competition
objective: Determine whether Phase1250's five-event response advantage requires a distributed observation bundle or is already captured by an explicit condition or one late answer state.
scope: Six free TinyCausalTransformers at 4, 6 and 8 layers; equal 80-dimensional camera budgets; frozen discovery, selection and confirmation groups; no pretrained model.
budget_status: The one-shot formal run used 0.093151 GPU-hour. No adaptive rerun was permitted.
success_condition: A frozen observation object wins across all six networks and three depths with group-held-out prediction and specificity; a late-single win rejects distributed observational necessity.
stop_condition: The one-shot run completes, any artifact audit fails, or a registered verdict is reached without event reselection.

stages.name: Known-truth causal-slice camera competition
stages.entry_gate: Phase1250 artifacts and the new camera families, dimensions, splits, seeds and thresholds are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Adjudicate ex-ante, late-single and distributed-camera claims across six networks without adaptive reselection.

name: Typed answer-state handoff campaign
objective: Test when source and later-mapping counterfactuals become causally sufficient and necessary at the answer state by layer-cut rescue and blocking.
scope: Six new free TinyCausalTransformers at 4, 6 and 8 layers; exhaustive layer cuts and typed position groups; source, mapping and joint counterfactuals; wrong-identity and matched-null controls.
budget_status: The one-shot formal run used 0.064853 GPU-hour. Identity and breadth failed, so pretrained-model escalation is blocked.
success_condition: At least five of six networks pass endpoint instrumentation, matched-null specificity, correct-versus-wrong identity and frozen rescue/block handoff gates.
stop_condition: The one-shot run completes, identity or breadth fails, artifacts fail audit, or the GPU budget is reached.

stages.name: Known-truth typed state handoff
stages.entry_gate: Counterfactual worlds, typed groups, layer cuts, identity controls and thresholds are frozen before CUDA execution.
stages.exit_gate: Confirm identity-conditioned handoff breadth or close automatic escalation without threshold changes.

name: Planted mechanism-edge and minimal-cut camera calibration
objective: Calibrate a typed QK/OV/MLP edge, identity-rescue and complete minimal-cut camera against sealed mechanism truth before using it on freely trained networks.
scope: 192 planted Transformer-shaped systems spanning serial, MLP, redundant, gated, compositional and gauge-rotated mechanisms; two sealed splits, four tasks and four gauges per split.
budget_status: The one-shot CUDA calibration used 0.052688 GPU-hour and passed all six registered truth gates.
success_condition: Exact recovery of active roles and complete minimal-cut families, identity-specific rescue, gauge invariance and output-twin separation in both sealed splits.
stop_condition: The one-shot calibration completes or any truth, audit or budget gate fails.

stages.name: Planted typed-edge and cut calibration
stages.entry_gate: Mechanism truth, opaque edge identities, global wrong donors, tasks, gauges and thresholds are sealed.
stages.exit_gate: All truth recovery, identity, twin and gauge gates pass or the camera is rejected.

name: Free Transformer typed-edge external-validity qualification
objective: Test the C006 typed-edge camera in six freely trained Transformers across 4, 6 and 8 layers.
scope: Six free TinyCausalTransformers, 128 counterfactual worlds, sparse prefix selection, correct rescue, wrong identity, matched null and reverse blocking.
budget_status: The one-shot CUDA run used 0.066489 GPU-hour; fused-versus-explicit arithmetic disqualified five of six models.
success_condition: At least four of six qualified models, with every depth represented, pass the complete rescue, identity, null and reverse-block conjunction.
stop_condition: The one-shot run completes, executor qualification or breadth fails, or artifact audit fails.

stages.name: Free-network edge-camera transfer
stages.entry_gate: Architectures, components, prefixes, splits and thresholds are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Confirm breadth or classify an executor-qualification boundary without interpreting unqualified interventions.

name: Same-executor free Transformer typed-edge coalition confirmation
objective: Repeat the unchanged C007 causal test with training, natural evaluation and intervention using one explicit arithmetic executor.
scope: Six new free 4/6/8-layer TinyCausalTransformers, unchanged thresholds and prefixes, 128 new counterfactual worlds and one terminal executor correction.
budget_status: The terminal one-shot CUDA run used 0.077804 GPU-hour; all six qualified and four passed, with every depth represented.
success_condition: At least four of six models and every depth pass correct rescue, identity, matched-null and reverse-block gates under identical arithmetic.
stop_condition: The terminal same-executor run completes; no third executor variant is permitted.

stages.name: Same-executor breadth confirmation
stages.entry_gate: C007 architectures, thresholds and prefix sizes remain unchanged while executor identity is enforced.
stages.exit_gate: Adjudicate the complete breadth conjunction and authorize at most one fresh Qwen3 contract.

name: Qwen3 FP16 answer-boundary typed-coalition external validity
objective: Test once whether a Q/OV/MLP answer-boundary coalition specifically rescues and blocks an unseen object-color counterfactual response in Qwen3-4B FP16.
scope: One Qwen3-4B model, one artificial English object-color interface, 128 worlds, eight candidate values and 108 layer-typed answer-boundary components.
budget_status: The one-shot full-CUDA FP16 run used 0.007270 GPU-hour. Behavior, rescue, identity and blocking passed, but matched-null specificity failed.
success_condition: Behavior qualification and the frozen confirmation rescue, identity, matched-null and reverse-block conjunction all pass.
stop_condition: Pass or fail closes this local campaign; no threshold, prompt, role or prefix rescan is permitted.

stages.name: One-shot Qwen3 typed-coalition test
stages.entry_gate: Qwen3 behavior passes all four panels before any trace capture; model, material, roles, prefixes and thresholds are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Confirm the complete scope-specific conjunction or close without another pretrained run.

name: Factorial head instrument and naturalized Qwen response decomposition
objective: Separate target-axis identity transport from orthogonal contextual transport with a calibrated Qwen-shaped head intervention and new held-out factorial material.
scope: One no-model/CUDA tensor calibration followed by one Qwen3-4B FP16 run on 256 new naturalized factorial worlds and 2,340 symmetric head/MLP candidates.
budget_status: WP01 used 0.000252 GPU-hour and passed 17/17 audit. WP02 used 0.009163 GPU-hour; behavior and identity passed, but held-out target-orthogonal null failed. C010 is closed.
success_condition: The instrument calibrates, then one newly selected coalition passes behavior, correct rescue, direct identity, decomposed null, conditional robustness and reverse blocking on held-out templates.
stop_condition: Any calibration gate fails, or the one-shot Qwen3 confirmation conjunction passes or fails; no repair run is permitted.

stages.name: Factorial geometry and head-slice calibration
stages.entry_gate: Phase1256 artifacts are frozen and no model forward is allowed.
stages.exit_gate: Exact tensor, GQA, geometry and identifiability-abstention gates pass.

stages.name: Qwen3 natural-factorial head coalition
stages.entry_gate: WP01 passes and new material, templates, components and thresholds are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: The complete held-out response conjunction passes or C010 closes.

name: Selective operator and path-mediation camera external validity
objective: Distinguish globally separable, control-conditioned and unidentifiable target/null responses in known truth, then test the unchanged camera in freely trained same-executor Transformers across depth.
scope: 384 known-truth systems followed by six free 4/6/8-layer TinyCausalTransformers, 512 frozen cyclic-code worlds and one behavior-first external-validity run.
budget_status: WP01 used approximately 0.0132 GPU-hour and passed all ten gates with 15/15 audit. WP02 used 0.073391 GPU-hour; all six models passed behavior but zero yielded two selected events. C011 is closed.
success_condition: The camera exactly recovers known truth, then at least four of six free models with every depth represented identify two events and pass target, context, wrong, null, mediation, manifold and control gates.
stop_condition: Any known-truth conjunction fails, or the one free-network run passes or fails; no threshold, seed, depth or event repair is permitted.

stages.name: Known-truth selective-operator and mediation calibration
stages.entry_gate: C010 is closed and six mechanism-truth families, camera candidates, thresholds and splits are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Global, conditioned and abstention truth plus target/context/wrong/null/path/manifold/control gates pass or the camera closes.

stages.name: Free Transformer cross-depth external validity
stages.entry_gate: WP01 passes and free-network architectures, seeds, worlds, events and thresholds are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: The complete breadth conjunction passes or C011 closes before pretrained escalation.

name: Factorial response compiler calibration and predictive-type boundary
objective: Replace target-preserve/null-zero projection with a complete A/B/J response compiler, calibrate finite compiler competition and typed abstention in known truth, then conditionally test free-network external validity.
scope: 336 known-truth conditional systems, seven mechanism families, two registry splits, four tasks, six replicates and 322,560 factorial cases; free-network WP02 was not authorized.
budget_status: WP01 used 0.007546 GPU-hour. Type recovery was 331/336 and two manifold-tail confirmations failed; independent audit passed 17/17. WP02 was denied and C012 is closed.
success_condition: All seven known-truth families are exactly typed, every applicable A1/B/J, identity, nuisance, path, manifold and control gate passes in both splits, then one separately frozen free-network phase passes its own breadth contract.
stop_condition: Any WP01 conjunction fails, or the one authorized free-network run passes or fails; no candidate, family, threshold, seed or bandwidth repair is permitted.

stages.name: Known-truth factorial response compiler calibration
stages.entry_gate: C011 is closed and the A/B/J object, seven families, finite compiler order, thresholds and splits are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Exact type and abstention recovery plus every applicable factorial, specificity, path, manifold, breadth and control gate passes or C012 closes.

stages.name: Free Transformer factorial compiler external validity
stages.entry_gate: WP01 passes exactly and architectures, seeds, factorial panels, candidate classes and thresholds are independently frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Not entered because WP01 failed.

name: Predictive functional equivalence and independent-rescue calibration
objective: Define mechanism type by a frozen unseen-risk quotient rather than generator identity, calibrate ambiguity abstention, and separate independently sourced rescue from algebraic replay.
scope: 320 known-truth conditional systems, eight source families, five predictive outcomes, two registry splits, four tasks, five replicates and 1,556,480 cases; free-network WP02 was not authorized.
budget_status: WP01 used 0.003025 GPU-hour. Functional type recovery was 318/320 and abstention 82/84; independent audit passed 16/16. WP02 was denied and C013 is closed.
success_condition: All 320 reference-risk functional classes and abstentions are recovered exactly, all applicable response, independent rescue, wrong, control, sentinel and split gates pass, then one separately frozen free-network phase passes its own breadth contract.
stop_condition: Any WP01 conjunction fails, or the one authorized free-network run passes or fails; no candidate, threshold, sample, source family or seed repair is permitted.

stages.name: Known-truth predictive-equivalence and independent-rescue calibration
stages.entry_gate: C012 is closed and predictive classes, risk margins, source families, donor provenance and leakage sentinel are frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Exact class and abstention recovery plus every applicable confirmation, independent-rescue, control, sentinel and split gate passes or C013 closes.

stages.name: Free Transformer predictive-equivalence external validity
stages.entry_gate: WP01 passes exactly and architectures, seeds, panels, candidates and donor provenance are independently frozen.
stages.exit_gate: Not entered because WP01 failed.
